title: Indian-Style Keto Burger
description: A flavorful and spicy keto burger inspired by Indian cuisine. Perfect for adventurous eaters and keto dieters.

ingredients.name: Burger
ingredients.notes: Look for a keto-friendly patty or make your own

ingredients.name: Bun
ingredients.amount: 1 (keto-friendly) bun made from almond flour or coconut flour
ingredients.notes: Make sure it's low in carbs

ingredients.name: Stir Fry Sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a low-carb stir fry sauce or make your own with coconut aminos and spices

instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet or grill over medium-high heat.
2. Add 1 tbsp of coconut oil to the skillet and swirl it around.
3. Place the burger patty in the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
4. While the burger is cooking, toast the keto-friendly bun on the grill or in the oven.

5. Once the burger is cooked, assemble the burger by spreading a layer of stir fry sauce on the bottom bun, followed by the burger patty, a sprinkle of chopped cilantro and scallions, and finally the top bun.
7. If using cilantro chutney, serve it on the side for added flavor.
